purpose: A number with both an exponent and a scale factor (`1e3k`) in an HSPICE deck is refused, as HSPICE forbids it.

oracle.derivation: Star-Hspice Manual, Release 1998.2, ch. 3 (class.ece.uw.edu/cadta/hspice/chapter_3.pdf) p. 3-20: "Numbers can use exponential format or engineering key letter format, but not both (1e-12 or 1p, but not 1e-6u)." ngspice reads 1e3k as 1e6, its own dialect, not HSPICE's rule.
oracle.confirmed_reason: No second simulator reads the HSPICE dialect: Xyce -hspice-ext is Xyce's own extension, not HSPICE; the manuals are the oracle.
